summary: Implemented the round-5 UX pass for Team Builder: the current 10-player panel is now a dense row-based summary with inline preference steppers, the results panel has a visible `후보 6개 다시 생성` action that re-rolls candidates without clearing current state, and the main shell/docs now include the GitHub issue inquiry path. Regression tests were extended and the static bundle was rebuilt.
completed_work: Refactored the preview renderer in `src/lib/render.js` to replace tall roster cards with compact `current-player-row` rows inside a capped `current-player-list-scroll` container while preserving the existing preference button id pattern.
Updated Korean UI copy in `src/constants/copy.js` to explain the dense current-match summary, hidden numeric balance scores, reroll workflow, and visible inquiry CTA.
Added a visible GitHub issue contact line to the main shell in `src/lib/render.js` linking to `https://github.com/haskell26/team-builder/issues`.

Added a result-toolbar reroll button in `src/lib/render.js` and wired it in `src/main.js` via a shared candidate rebuild helper so reroll only refreshes candidates/editor state from `state.matchPlayers`.
Kept ranking behavior unchanged by reusing the existing `buildBalanceFromPlayers(...)` path rather than modifying optimizer precedence.

Reworked `src/styles.css` for dense current-player rows, compact stepper controls, capped-height scrolling, result toolbar styling, and responsive behavior that stays compact without horizontal overflow.

Extended `test/appFlow.test.js` to cover dense current-player row rendering, inquiry CTA presence, reroll button presence, and deterministic reroll preservation of textarea/current-player/saved-selection state.
Extended `test/responsiveLayout.test.js` to cover the new dense current-player layout hooks, capped-height container, truncation behavior, and reroll/contact styling hooks.
Updated `README.md` and `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` to document the dense current-match UI, reroll flow, GitHub issue contact path, and truthful verification status.
Ran the build so `dist/` reflects the updated round-5 source files.

verification.result: Passed and rebuilt the static bundle in `dist/`.

known_gaps: `npm run test:browser` was not run in this environment, so real browser/mobile smoke remains unverified. Per the round-5 spec, that gap is non-blocking for this handoff.
handoff_notes: Reroll intentionally resets the final editor to the newly ranked candidate 1 and discards any prior manual swap state.
The reroll handler only refreshes result/editor state; it does not clear `clipboardText`, `matchPlayers`, saved-player records, or saved-player selections.
The workspace already had `.harness/spec.md` and `.harness/plan.json` marked modified before handoff; I did not edit them.
